User brief: "Ironspike — The Siege Ballista. A heavy timber-and-iron ballista that launches great bolts through enemies lined up along the road. Its identity is a castle’s siege defense, rewarding a clear firing lane with brutal piercing force."

Subject: a heavy defensive ballista mounted high on a stout open timber trestle. Three dominant masses only: broad angular crossbow limbs, a central thick wooden launch stock with one seated iron-headed great bolt, and a strong squared timber supporting frame with a broad clear opening underneath. Simple iron bands brace the timber joints; a visible taut cord connects the bow tips behind the seated bolt. Believable weight and unobstructed forward launch rail. This is a tall stationary castle defense engine, not a cart. Give the foot just a few low chunky crumbly stones, no large mound or terrain tile. No battlement pedestal, building walls, roof, windows, fire, banners, people, emblems, or decoration.
Orientation: DIRECTLY FRONT FACING, perfectly centered, slightly elevated view only enough to see the top of the stock and a foreshortened loaded bolt pointing toward the viewer/down the image. Never 3/4 yaw or side-facing. Symmetric core and support feet.
Canvas: square 1024x1024 RGBA with a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, NOT a checkerboard painting. Fixed structural center x=512. Lowest ground-contact point y=896. Keep the entire tier-one silhouette approximately within x=220..804, y=400..896, leaving ample transparent space above and beside it for cumulative upgrades. Core support width about 300px. Do not fill the canvas or crop. No text or labels.

Readable as a 100px game sprite. No dense tiny braces, rivets, masonry or surface detailing.
